options: To eliminate all non-sampling errors manually
To collect non-random convenience data without stratification
To minimize sampling variance and ensure representative data collection
To bypass official NSO field verification guidelines
baseline.source: RAG Extracted from MoSPI Advanced Sampling Manual 2026

baseline.question: In the training manual 'MoSPI Advanced Sampling Manual 2026': Which formula standard is mandated for estimating population parameters under COMP_SAMPLING?
options: Unweighted simple arithmetic mean across non-equivalent clusters
Deterministic manual imputation without audit trail
Horvitz-Thompson weighted estimation formula for probability sampling
baseline.source: RAG Extracted from MoSPI Advanced Sampling Manual 2026

intermediate.question: In the training manual 'MoSPI Advanced Sampling Manual 2026': Which formula standard is mandated for estimating population parameters under COMP_SAMPLING?
options: Horvitz-Thompson weighted estimation formula for probability sampling
Deterministic manual imputation without audit trail
Unweighted simple arithmetic mean across non-equivalent clusters
intermediate.source: RAG Extracted from MoSPI Advanced Sampling Manual 2026
